The '''Ortus Farm''' is a farm to the west of [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. The farm has [[chicken]]s, [[buffalo]]s, and [[alpaca]]s. Part of the [[Fortis Aqueduct]] also transports freshwater from [[Ralos' Rise]] to it.

==Features==
* A water pump is located in the northern part of the farm, which can be used as a [[water|water source]]. It is the closest water source to the nearby [[allotment patch]].
* An [[allotment patch]], [[herb patch]], and [[flower patch]] are on the south side of the farm.
** [[Harminia]] can be paid nearby to watch over the allotments.
** When the player has achieved the rank of Champion or higher at the [[Fortis Colosseum]], citizens will provide protection to the herb patch. 
* [[Agelus]] runs [[Agelus' Farm Shop]] next to the farming patches
* A number of animals can be found around the farm:
**12 [[buffalo]]
**11 [[chicken]]s
**7 [[alpaca]]s, which can be sheared for [[wool]]
**1 [[Dairy Buffalo]], which can be [[Bucket of milk|milked]]
